usdRate.sourceName: Magyar Nemzeti Bank official exchange rate (USD)
usdRate.note: HUF 326.64 per US dollar on 30 October 2026 (EUR 365.80); World Bank 2025 average 353.14.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Hungarian Central Statistical Office (KSH), consumer price index flash release, September 2026
inflation_cpi.note: Consumer prices were 1.6% higher than a year earlier in September 2026 (1.3% in August), released 7 October 2026. HICP averaged 4.4% in 2025.

inflation_projection.sourceName: MNB 3% inflation target (tolerance band 2-4%); Hungarian HICP 2021-2025 average 9.1% (ECB ICP)
inflation_projection.note: The MNB targets 3% but Hungary has repeatedly overshot it (15-17% in 2022-23), so planning uses 3.5%, slightly above the target even though CPI is 1.6% now.

policy_rate.sourceName: Magyar Nemzeti Bank, MNB Decree of 25 August 2026 on the central bank base rate
policy_rate.note: Base rate cut to 5.50% in August 2026 and held at the 22 September and 20 October 2026 Monetary Council meetings (corridor 4.50-6.50%).

savings_account_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics (reported by the MNB): Hungarian banks, overnight forint deposits from households
savings_account_rate.note: Average rate on household overnight (sight and savings) forint deposits was 0.17% in August 2026 (0.21% in July).

fdr_3m_rate.note: The MNB and ECB publish household term deposits up to 1 year as one bucket (4.05% in August 2026); no separate 3-month average was found.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics (reported by the MNB): household forint deposits with agreed maturity up to 1 year, new business
fdr_1y_rate.note: Bucket covers all fixed terms up to one year (4.24% in July 2026); 1-2 year deposits paid 3.40% in August 2026.

dps_rate.note: No standard monthly recurring-deposit product with a published average rate was found for Hungary; the state-subsidised home savings scheme closed to new contracts in 2018.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: Magyar Nemzeti Bank, interest rate statistics release, August 2026 (household forint term deposits, new contracts)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Average rate on new household forint term deposits of all maturities was 3.95% in August 2026, down 0.18 points from July (4.81% a year earlier); World Bank FR.INR.DPST gives 5.71% for 2025.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.sourceName: Government Debt Management Agency (ÁKK) retail bond MÁP Plusz series from 17 July 2026, as reported by economx.hu
sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: New 5-year Hungarian Government Security Plus series pays a stepped rate rising from 5.00% to 6.00% (5.00, 5.25, 5.50, 5.75, 6.00%), 5.48% a year on average; secondary source because the ÁKK offering page loads by script. Third cut in 2026.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Government Debt Management Agency (ÁKK), benchmark yields, 3-month

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: Government Debt Management Agency (ÁKK), benchmark yields, 5-year

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: Government Debt Management Agency (ÁKK), benchmark yields, 10-year
tbond_10y_rate.note: 10-year benchmark yield (2037/A bond) 5.45% on 30 October 2026; ECB long-term convergence yield for Hungary 5.69% in September 2026.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Hungary income determination
tax_bank_interest.note: 15% personal income tax plus 13% social contribution tax on interest from instruments bought after 1 July 2023 (bank deposits, treasury bills, funds); 0% or 10% inside a long-term investment account held 5 or 3 years.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: Government Debt Management Agency (ÁKK), Hungarian Government Security Plus (MÁP Plusz)
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No interest tax is charged on MÁP Plusz, and series issued after 1 June 2019 are exempt from the social contribution tax; product rules page dated October 2024, still in force.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: National Deposit Insurance Fund of Hungary (OBA), amount of compensation
deposit_insurance_limit.note: EUR 100,000 per depositor per bank, paid in forints at the MNB rate of the day before payout; converted at EUR 1 = HUF 365.80 (MNB, 30 October 2026). An extra EUR 50,000 covers certain temporary high balances.

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics (reported by the MNB): Hungarian banks, extended credit card credit to households
credit_card_rate_cap.note: Typical rate, not the legal cap: average 24.12% in August 2026. By law the APR (THM) on credit cards may not exceed the MNB base rate plus 39 percentage points.

equity_return_low.sourceName: BUX index 145,257 on 30 Oct 2026, up 35% in a year (Trading Economics); after-tax 1-year deposit about 2.9%
equity_return_low.note: Low case: Hungarian shares give back recent gains and earn only a little more than tax-free government securities.

equity_return_base.sourceName: BUX index (Trading Economics); tax-free MÁP Plusz 5.48%
equity_return_base.note: Base case: about 2.5 points over the tax-free retail government bond rate, below the strong 10-year BUX record because the index is concentrated in a few large companies.

equity_return_high.sourceName: BUX index (Trading Economics), roughly 15% a year over 2016-2026
equity_return_high.note: High case: Hungarian and diversified equity funds keep close to their strong forint returns of the last decade.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Gold USD price history (Trading Economics); forint per dollar 326.64 (MNB, 30 Oct 2026)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: gold stalls after the 2025-26 spike and the forint stays stable against the dollar.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Gold USD price history (Trading Economics); MNB 3% inflation target
gold_return_base.note: Base case: dollar gold rises with world inflation plus a little, and the forint loses about 1.5% a year against the dollar as it has over the long run.

gold_return_high.note: High case: a repeat of gold's strong 2005-2025 trend in forint terms.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Household deposits up to 1 year 4.05% less 28% tax = 2.9% (ECB MIR)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: after-tax bank term deposits only.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: After-tax 1-year deposit 2.9%; tax-free MÁP Plusz 5.48% average
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: a mix of tax-free retail government securities and after-tax deposits, allowing for further rate cuts.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: mostly tax-free retail government securities at today's rates.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The MNB (insurance supervisor) publishes insurance market statistics, but no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life cover is sold in Hungary, but no regulator or official premium table per sum insured was found; only individual company quotes exist.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Hospital care is free under NEAK public health insurance; no official figure for the out-of-pocket cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: Private health insurance is sold in Hungary, but no published premium table per HUF 100,000 of cover from a regulator or public source was found.

oop_health_share.note: Out-of-pocket spending was 23.1% of current health expenditure in 2023 (latest available; older than 2025).

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Eurostat/ECB HICP Hungary, health: 7.0% year on year in December 2025
goal_inflation_health.note: Health prices have risen faster than general prices (7.0% vs 3.3% in December 2025), so planning uses 5.5%, two points above general inflation.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Eurostat/ECB HICP Hungary, education: 6.6% year on year in December 2025
goal_inflation_education.note: Education prices rose 6.6% in 2025, well above general inflation; planning uses 5%.

life_expectancy.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_expectancy.note: Men 74.3, women 80.6 (UN WPP estimate for 2026); World Bank 2024 figure 76.7.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years computed from georank's expected age at death by current age (UN WPP 2026 estimate).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 32.8 (2025, World Bank), 39.5 (2040) and 47.7 (2065, populationpyramid.net/hungary/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: European Commission, Your social security rights in Hungary (July 2026)
retirement_age_default.note: Old-age pension age is 65 for everyone born in 1957 or later, men and women; women with 40 years of eligibility can retire earlier at any age.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: European Commission, Your social security rights in Hungary (July 2026)
retirement_age_government.note: Civil servants are covered by the same statutory pension insurance, so the general pension age of 65 applies.

retirement_return_low.note: Low case: after-tax deposits with some further rate cuts.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: 3-month treasury bill 5.14% less 28% tax = 3.7% (ÁKK); after-tax 1-year deposit 2.9%
retirement_return_base.note: Base case: kept below the after-tax treasury bill rate, with some tax-free retail government securities in the mix.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: mostly tax-free retail government securities, held to maturity.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if shares lag.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half shares at 8% and half safe fixed income at about 4%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning balanced mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: European Commission, Your social security rights in Hungary (July 2026): old-age allowance (időskorúak járadéka)
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: HUF 43,700 a month for a single person from pension age to 74 with no income (HUF 37,165 per person in a couple, HUF 58,990 alone at 75+); income is deducted. The government plans to roughly double these amounts from January 2027.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: Act III of 1993 on social administration, sections 32/B-32/C (National Legislation Database)
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Pension age (65), income below the allowance amount (100% of the minimum pension base for singles under 75, 85% per person for couples, 135% for singles 75+), legal residence in Hungary.

gratuity_rule.note: The Labour Code gives severance pay (végkielégítés) only on dismissal, scaled in months of pay by length of service (1 month after 3 years up to 6 months after 25), not a days-per-year retirement gratuity; no source stating the current scale was read.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: European Commission, Your social security rights in Hungary (July 2026)
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory earnings-related state pension: pension age 65 with at least 20 years of service (minimum pension HUF 28,500, to rise to HUF 120,000 from January 2027); raised each January by forecast CPI with later correction. Pensions are tax-exempt income under the Personal Income Tax Act.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring-deposit product; the subsidised home savings scheme (lakás-takarékpénztár) closed to new contracts in 2018.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: 5-year retail government security with a stepped fixed rate, free of interest tax; sold by the State Treasury, post offices and banks.

tbill_91d.note: 3-, 6- and 12-month bills auctioned by ÁKK; interest taxed at 28%.

equity_fund.note: Retail mutual funds and exchange-traded index funds are widely available; a long-term investment account (TBSZ) lowers the tax after 3-5 years.

gold.note: Buying physical gold bars and coins is legal and VAT-exempt.

centralBank.name: Magyar Nemzeti Bank (Central Bank of Hungary)

insuranceRegulator.name: Magyar Nemzeti Bank (financial supervisor for insurers)

insuranceComplaints.name: Financial Arbitration Board (Pénzügyi Békéltető Testület)
insuranceComplaints.note: Out-of-court dispute body for consumers in disputes with insurers and banks, operated by the MNB.

oldAgeAllowance.name: Old-age allowance (időskorúak járadéka), Act III of 1993 sections 32/B-32/C
oldAgeAllowance.note: Claimed at the district government office (járási hivatal).

publicHealthCover.name: NEAK (National Health Insurance Fund of Hungary)

depositInsurance.name: National Deposit Insurance Fund of Hungary (OBA)
